# The Outdoorsy Artist

> Lori Oswald's creative portfolio blending outdoor adventure with fine art through paintings, commissions, and instructional content.

The Outdoorsy Artist is the personal brand and portfolio of Lori Oswald, an artist specializing in acrylic paintings, custom commissions, and outdoor-inspired artwork. The site combines art instruction, a gallery of original works, and lifestyle content around hiking and Colorado mountain culture.

## Key Topics

- Lori Oswald
- Acrylic painting
- Art commissions
- Custom portraits
- Painting tutorials
- 14ers (Colorado mountains)
- Hiking training
- Figure art
- Outdoor-inspired art
- Beginner painting supplies
- Color palette
- Artist portfolio
- Art for sale
- Symbolism in art
